title: Great improvements
body:
Some great improvements to the app this year which as a user of Liv and Mashreq make this far more usable as a banking app. Actually closing Mashreq account due to the number of issues I have with it!

Clear layout and access to main banking functions, does what you need from a banking app and makes life a lot easier
author: QUAD-ratic

title: Pretty rubbish
body:
As banking apps go this continues to be one of the poor ones.
Good points - facial recognition to login, easy to see your main account balance, templates for transfers to other accounts in UAE and other countries (can be saved), online payment of credit cards.
Bad points - extremely muddled and in fact incorrect presentation of credit cards and supplementary cards and their transactions, continues to show some (but not all) blocked and expired cards even after the user designating favourites or cards being replaced. Even the supplementary card shows before my own cards! Most of the time the app mixes the transactions of different cards under the wrong card. I end up relying on the text messages, PDF or printed statements because the app is so poor.
Despite raising the shortcomings on several versions ago it is still an issue today!
author: Devonshire.dumpling

title: Worst update ever!
body:
Ive been using you bank and app for many years and never had an issue with your updates or re-registering. This time though I have deleted the app and reinstalled 5 or 6 times and tried to register upwards of 15 times and it stalls at the same point every time —— the ‘check if you’re alive’ function does not work! And you cant get past it! 

Ive made repeated complaints to the Bank technical team who refuse to acknowledge that theres an issue - they believe I am a robot, dead or not human, as this logically can be the only reason why I’m not able to register…🤷🏼‍♀️ erm maybe theres an issue with the app rather than the person? 

Please resolve this issue! (Why you cant use the same facial recognition software as the phone, that works, is beyond me!)

title: Poor banking experience
body:

I randomly received a notification from aramex saying that I’ve got a delivery and then I got my cheque book. 
Also, they randomly take my money each month, but I don’t have any paid subscriptions. I opened a ticket and got a refund in August, however I end up in the same situation in September. I hope that support agents will refund me on that, but I’ve got a feeling that they just have a bug in their system that steals moneys from clients

title: Mobile banking And debit card blocked
body:
My Experience with FAB Bank – Very Disappointing

I am very disappointed with my experience with FAB Bank. My Mobile Banking App and debit card have been blocked since 5 October 2026. Despite submitting all the requested documents and contacting Customer Care almost daily, my issue remains unresolved.

This prolonged delay and lack of a satisfactory response have caused me unnecessary stress and difficulties in managing my daily financial transactions.

I understand that banks must carry out security checks and verification procedures, but customers should receive timely updates and proper support throughout the process.

Unfortunately, this experience has significantly reduced my confidence in FAB Bank, and I would not recommend its services based on my experience. I sincerely hope FAB improves its customer service and resolves such issues more efficiently in the future.

Regards,
Soe Thiri

title: Worst App
body:
I've used many banking apps, and this is the worst one I've faced. I have a 5G connection, so my internet is not the issue, but the FAB app is extremely laggy and slow to respond. The customization options are also limited and unclear, and I couldn't set up the app the way I wanted.

For a bank app, performance and ease of use should be basic. My honest advice to FAB is to fix these problems urgently or pull the app from the app stores until they're resolved.

title: Very Disappointing Customer Service Experience with FAB Bank
body:
My experience with FAB Bank has been extremely disappointing. Their customer service is difficult to reach, calls often go unanswered, and even when trying to get assistance, the waiting time is unnecessarily long.

Getting a UAE driving licence seems easier than getting connected to a FAB customer service agent! It is frustrating that even a simple enquiry requires so much time and effort just to speak to a representative.

To make matters worse, I personally visited the FAB Shahama Branch in Abu Dhabi to resolve my issue. However, the branch staff informed me that they could not do anything to assist and that I must contact customer service instead. I was also told that the branch could not handle credit card-related issues. This raises a serious question: what is the purpose of visiting a bank branch if customers are simply redirected to a customer service department that is already difficult to reach?

A bank should provide accessible customer support and take responsibility for resolving customer issues rather than sending customers from one channel to another.

Considering this ongoing poor service and lack of proper support, I have decided to close my bank account and cancel all my credit cards with FAB.

I would not recommend FAB Bank to anyone who values reliable customer service, proper support and a hassle-free banking experience.
